verdict.rationale: Docs show Skills can be uploaded/managed via the Skills API and invoked in Messages API requests via the container parameter (up to 20 skills), mirroring the ability to create/use skills in Claude.ai and Claude Code UI/CLI. However, there's no explicit evidence of full parity for other Skills-adjacent UI features like plugin marketplaces, agent view, or agent teams being API-accessible in the same way, and community feedback notes unreliable triggering regardless of surface. Missing for 10: explicit comparison confirming all UI-exposed skill management/discovery features (marketplaces, auto-invocation controls, agent view) are equally available via API, and independent verification of API-side parity.
